sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

refinement.note: Twelve approximate native-image edge readings at GP1 approach section455 and bend sections470..490every5. The cast shadow at section465 obscures the edges, so no measurement is claimed there; the455-to470 interval interpolates the visible neighbouring controls. Source-normal tick overlays distinguish the pavement/curb edges from internal paving contrasts. Half-metre-rounded readings, not nominal widths or surveyed racing limits. Faint outer paint, broad curbs and sparse normal interpolation remain uncertain. Seed ends preserve the uncorrected proposal. Reused coordinates require same image/seed pins and existing direction, branch ambiguity, proximity and1.5m along-route guards. GP5 reuses only the shared approach and bend through section485; section490 is a preserved seed endpoint because its outgoing bypass differs.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been formally verified; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. The source centreline was checked against this image; candidate edges must bracket its smoothed cross-sections. This opt-in constraint does not set a road width or establish positional accuracy. It is unsuitable for an unaligned source trace. Sparse edge anchors measured on the pinned image correct the documented sections. Evidence scores describe the original automatic proposal, not the corrected borders. The seed and final border hashes and correction recipe are retained.
